description: Keeping a package fast on the sites that install it: the published cache over the services layer, tree traversal, caching lookups and clearing them, data type config and converter cache levels, output cache eviction, light hot paths, and backoffice screens that don't over-fetch. Use when writing, changing or reviewing code that runs per request, per save, per indexed item or at startup (property value converters, notification handlers, indexing), code that loops over every content item (a full rebuild, an import, a sync), or a list or search screen. Not for a site's own templates.
